{{Quote|Aunt&hellip;since times are becoming so&hellip;complicated, perhaps you might consider sending the baby to the communal nursery for each day? Then it would be easier to concentrate on our business. The child is well able to spend long periods outside your pouch. Besides, they have surrogate pouch-mothers at the nursery.|Jabba Desilijic Tiure, to his aunt Jiliac Desilijic Tiron|<ref name="RD">''[[Rebel Dawn]]''</ref>}}
The '''communal nursery''' was a location on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] where [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] mothers could send their huttlets each day so they could better focus on their occupations. The communal nursery was staffed by surrogate Hutt [[pouch-mother]]s who would nurse the huttlets in their [[Brood pouch/Legends|brood pouches]]. Around a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] attempted to convince his aunt [[Jiliac Desilijic Tiron]] to place her [[Jiliac Desilijic Tiron's child|huttlet]] in a communal nursery each day so she could better focus on her duties as the leader of the [[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]].<ref name="RD" />
